metadata.description: Ground truth queries for FAISS semantic retrieval evaluation across multiple similarity thresholds.

queries.rationale: Query directly targets auto-renewal clause Section 5.

queries.query: Can I get a refund if I cancel my subscription early?
queries.rationale: Query targets the non-refundable payment policy in Section 6.

queries.query: How much advance notice is required to cancel my subscription?
queries.rationale: Query targets Section 5 notice period (at least 30 days prior).

queries.query: Does the company share my personal information with advertisers?
queries.rationale: Query targets Section 13 sharing data with ad partners for cross-site tracking.

queries.query: How long is my data stored after closing my account?
queries.rationale: Query targets Section 14 7-year data retention post-termination.

queries.query: What is the maximum monetary liability of the company?
queries.rationale: Query targets Section 17 $50 aggregate liability damage cap.

queries.query: Can I sue the company in a class action lawsuit?
queries.rationale: Query targets Section 19 class action waiver.

queries.query: Does the company have the right to modify prices without notice?
queries.rationale: Query relates to unilateral price modifications in Section 7 and terms modifications in Section 10.

queries.query: What are the rules regarding marketplace commission fee changes?
queries.rationale: Query targets Section 7 unilateral commission fee changes.

queries.query: Can disputes be resolved in small claims court instead of arbitration?
queries.rationale: Query targets Section 15 arbitration and Section 16 small claims exception.

queries.query: Am I required to indemnify the marketplace for copyright claims?
queries.rationale: Query targets Section 9 merchant indemnification clause.

queries.query: How many days notice must I give to cancel my store subscription?
queries.rationale: Query targets Section 5 15-day cancellation notice requirement.

queries.query: Does the app grant a perpetual license to use my uploaded photos?
queries.rationale: Query targets Section 7 perpetual license and Section 8 sublicensing.

queries.query: Can the platform terminate my account without any prior notice?
queries.rationale: Query targets Section 4 immediate termination without prior notice.

queries.query: Are digital gifts and virtual badges refundable if I change my mind?
queries.rationale: Query targets Section 6 non-refundable digital goods policy.

queries.query: What happens if these API terms conflict with a signed enterprise contract?
queries.rationale: Query targets Section 13 enterprise agreement precedence override.

queries.query: What is the maximum damages cap under these API terms?
queries.rationale: Query targets Section 15 $100 damage limitation cap.

queries.query: Can DataForge deprecate API endpoints without advance notice?
queries.rationale: Query targets Section 12 unilateral API modifications and deprecation.
